description: A new light vector boson that couples to neutrinos.

questions.question: What is the vector mediator mass in MeV?
questions.reason: 10 MeV is a conventional light-mediator benchmark in the supplied conventions, but the description gives no numerical mass.

questions.question: What are the dimensionless neutrino couplings g_nu^{alpha beta} multiplying Zprime_mu nu-bar_alpha gamma^mu P_L nu_beta, including their flavor pattern, signs, and any off-diagonal complex entries?
What is the dimensionless vector coupling g_u multiplying Zprime_mu u-bar gamma^mu u, including its sign and any mixing-induced contribution, or is it explicitly zero?
What is the dimensionless vector coupling g_d multiplying Zprime_mu d-bar gamma^mu d, including its sign and any mixing-induced contribution, or is it explicitly zero?

answers.free_text: mass 30 MeV, coupling 1e-4 to all three left-handed neutrino flavors and the same coupling 1e-4 to both u and d quarks, nothing else
